Name: Fixed Railroad Access to Summit
Author: DevilBro
Description:
This mod adds the stairs behind the railroad that could be seen in some beta pictures.
This enabled the player to go to the summit of the mountain.

There is currently nothing to do at the summit, so everything there is cosmetic, though the trees
can be chopped down and they will regrow autom. like everywhere else.
Foraging items can also be found in the new areas.

Unzip the zip and add the files/folders into your Content folder.

Known bugs:
Wheatereffects are not shown on the summit, this can't be fixed by myself, only by ConcernedApe.
Background effects like birds or a hot air balloon might glitch over the ground, also not fixable by me.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the stairs at the railroad and gives access to summit.
